highlights.title: Bots download and upload files in their browser
highlights.text: A bot can open menus that show only on hover, save a page's download in its own folder and give a page's file picker a file. Under Ask, each upload asks you first.

highlights.title: Dictate into the message box
highlights.text: Press the mic between @ and Send and talk. The words land in the box for you to read over, with Undo, and nothing is sent until you press Send.

highlights.title: Dictate on your phone too
highlights.text: On a phone the mic sits where Send is until you start typing, so you can say a long message instead of typing it.

highlights.title: Every part of your request on the done card
highlights.text: A done card lists the parts of your request, in your words, as Passed, Not met or No check, so a part nothing verified stands out.

highlights.title: Double-checks where they count
highlights.text: A routine run is double-checked on its first run, after its instructions change, and then at most once a week. While a check runs, you see which task is checked, by whom and why.

highlights.title: Offers after a failed step don't count as Blocked
highlights.text: When a step fails and the bot only offers choices, like "I can retry, or try another way", it no longer shows as Blocked or asks you with a question card.

fixes: Memory search no longer lists unrelated notes; with no real match the bot now sees "No matching notes."
API errors now always have a plain sentence and a short code.
